scheme_name: Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme
description:
The Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme was launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh on August 15, 2021. 

This scheme is named after Chetan Chauhan, a former cricketer and politician who served as the Minister of Sports in Uttar Pradesh. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote sports among laborers and their children. 

The government aims to provide financial assistance and support to enhance the participation of laborers in sports activities. 

The scheme specifically targets the children of laborers who may not have the financial means to pursue sports professionally. 

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to identify and nurture talent among the youth from labor backgrounds. 

The government has set a goal to provide training and resources to at least 5,000 children under this scheme in its initial phase. 

The scheme also aims to increase awareness about sports and physical fitness among labor communities. 

Financial assistance under this scheme includes a one-time grant of ₹50,000 for each selected child. 

This grant is intended to cover expenses related to training, equipment, and participation in competitions. 

In addition to the financial support, the scheme also provides access to coaching facilities. 

Qualified coaches will be made available to the beneficiaries to ensure proper training and skill development. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined. 

Applicants must be children of registered laborers in Uttar Pradesh. 

The age limit for applicants is set between 6 to 18 years. 

The laborers must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996. 

Income criteria stipulate that the family income of the laborer should not exceed ₹3 lakh per annum. 

To apply for the Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme, applicants must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Uttar Pradesh Sports Department. 

Applicants must fill out the online application form available on the website. 

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of labor registration, and income certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must provide a birth certificate or school certificate as proof of age. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the designated authorities. 

The timeline for application submission is typically open for three months from the date of announcement. 

Disbursement of funds occurs within 30 days after the approval of the application. 

The scheme is implemented by the Uttar Pradesh Sports Department. 

The contact details for the department are available on their official website. 

The department can be reached via phone or email for any queries regarding the scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for the initial phase of the scheme. 

This budget is expected to support the training and development of around 2,000 children in the first year. 

The scheme also aims to collaborate with local sports clubs and organizations to facilitate training. 

Regular workshops and sports camps will be organized to enhance skills and provide exposure. 

The government plans to monitor the progress of beneficiaries through periodic assessments. 

Feedback from coaches and beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme. 

The Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote sports in Uttar Pradesh. 

The state government has been focusing on enhancing sports infrastructure and facilities. 

This scheme aligns with the national agenda of promoting sports at the grassroots level. 

The government believes that sports can play a crucial role in the overall development of children. 

By providing financial support and training, the scheme aims to build a healthier and more active generation. 

The initiative also seeks to instill discipline and teamwork among the youth. 

In addition to individual sports, the scheme encourages participation in team sports as well. 

The government emphasizes the importance of sports in education and personal development. 

The scheme is expected to create a positive impact on the lives of labor families. 

By nurturing talent, the government hopes to produce future sports stars from underprivileged backgrounds. 

The Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme is a significant step towards inclusivity in sports. 

It aims to break barriers and provide equal opportunities for children of laborers. 

The initiative reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and sports promotion. 

The scheme is expected to be a game-changer for many aspiring athletes from labor communities. 

Overall, the Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme represents a holistic approach to sports development. 

It combines financial assistance with training and mentorship to empower the youth. 

The government encourages eligible families to take advantage of this scheme. 

By doing so, they can pave the way for a brighter future through sports. 

The scheme is a testament to the belief that talent can emerge from any background. 

With the right support and resources, children from labor families can excel in sports. 

The initiative is a significant contribution to the sports ecosystem in Uttar Pradesh. 

It aims to foster a culture of sports and physical fitness among all sections of society. 

The government is optimistic about the long-term benefits of this scheme. 

It envisions a future where sports become a viable career option for many. 

The Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme is a crucial development in this regard. 

It is a clear indication of the government's focus on youth empowerment through sports. 

The scheme is expected to evolve and expand in the coming years. 

The government remains committed to providing continuous support to beneficiaries. 

This initiative is a part of a larger vision to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. 

The Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme is a landmark effort in this direction.
